charts.title: HD 202772 A b: orbits around HD 202772 A
charts.description: The orbits of HD 202772 A's planets in this map from above, to scale, with HD 202772 A b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Jofré et al. 2025 (2025MNRAS.544.3994J), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname JOFRE_ET_AL_2025): P 3.3088775 d

charts.title: HD 202772 A b: its transit
charts.description: HD 202772 A b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (68, 92, 95) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 290131778, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, then averaged in 23-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Folded on the app's orbit; 23-min bins.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
